text:
maya: Failing CI on routing-rule-suggester tests. Looks like the console save path is reordering keys/comments and our lint CI flags it as a breaking change. repro attached.

sam: ugh. which serializer are we using in the console save flow? ruamel?

maya: ruamel via a tiny adapter. repro YAML: 
```yaml
# intent: route for internal metrics
- route_id: metrics-ingest
  match:
    path: /ingest/metrics
    headers:
      X-Auth: internal
  quota: 1000
  metadata: {team: infra}
```
When saved from the Rule Suggester UI the output becomes: 
```yaml
- route_id: metrics-ingest
  metadata: {team: infra}
  quota: 1000
  match:
    headers:
      X-Auth: internal
    path: /ingest/metrics
# intent: route for internal metrics
```
That trailing comment moves and lint treats it as touched and blocks the PR.

liam: I think ruamel preserves comments if you use round_trip_load + round_trip_dump and keep the same key sequence. Our adapter normalizes to a Python dict which loses ruamel's comment nodes.

anya: Is the lint rule actually about ordering, or just comment churn? Might be simpler to relax CI to ignore comment-only diffs.

maya: The policy is 'minimal-churn' for console updates because customers complain about noisy diffs. We can't just relax.

console-bot: CI job routing-lint #342 failed: 1 changed file (comment moved). Build log: 
```
--- a/routes.yaml
+++ b/routes.yaml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
-# intent: route for internal metrics
 - route_id: metrics-ingest
   match:
@@
```

sam: Two options I see: 1) teach the adapter to preserve ruamel internal structure (preferred), or 2) implement a post-save 'canonicalizer' that reorders keys to a deterministic layout the lint expects.

liam: 1) is doable but a bit risky across all code paths. My plan: extend our serializer to keep a small set of preservation rules: comments anchored to scalar nodes, keep list ordering, and prefer existing node positions when merging UI suggestions. Prototype: use ruamel's CommentedMap passthrough and only mutate values we need.

anya: We should add a unit test that loads the original YAML as comment-aware AST, runs the Rule Suggester transform, then dumps and asserts that comment positions for anchors we care about (like top-level comments and header comments) are preserved. That will catch regressions.

maya: Agree. Also adding a Console UX tweak: show a 'diff preview' modal on save with a toggle 'Minimal churn (preserve comments & order)'. Default ON for orgs with strict lint.

sam: Can the modal include a quick 'accept upstream formatting' link to bypass minimal-churn in case of necessary reformat?

maya: Yes. We'll expose 'force-format' but warn.

liam: I'll pick up the serializer prototype. Plan: implement CommentedMap passthrough, add a fallback canonicalizer that only reorders when keys missing. ETA end of week.

anya: I'll add the AST-preservation unit tests to the routing-config repo and wire them into the lint job. Test will assert comment anchors and top comment text equal.

sam: I'll update the console save flow to call the new serializer and add the diff modal. Small UI, should be ok.

maya: Thanks. Can we add a short engineer-facing doc in eng-platform/README about 'save semantics' (round-trip vs normalize) so future contributors know the constraints?

liam: yeah I'll add that after the PR.

maya: Pinging @sam for design for the diff modal copy and @anya for the test shapes. :eyes:

sam: got it, will mock copy and a tiny screenshot.

console-bot: Created task ENG-PLAT-871: "Preserve YAML comments/order on Rule Suggester save" assigned to liam, sam, anya. :white_check_mark:
